sql: WITH family_listings AS (SELECT family, SUM(open_listings) AS listings_count FROM mart_daily_market WHERE crawl_date = '2026-09-29' AND remote_us = TRUE GROUP BY family), total_listings AS (SELECT SUM(open_listings) AS total_count FROM mart_daily_market WHERE crawl_date = '2026-09-29' AND remote_us = TRUE) SELECT fl.family, fl.listings_count, (fl.listings_count * 1.0 / tl.total_count) AS share_of_total FROM family_listings AS fl CROSS JOIN total_listings AS tl ORDER BY fl.listings_count DESC
